canonical_project: Saudi Cloud Computing Company (SCCC) / Alibaba Cloud Riyadh data centers
owner: SCCC (stc Group, Alibaba Cloud, eWTP Arabia Capital, SCAI, SITE)
notes: Saudi Cloud Computing Company, the stc Group-Alibaba Cloud joint venture, launched cloud services from two data centers in Riyadh (announced 2022); Defense One (May 2025) confirms the twin availability-zone data centers in Riyadh serve government ministries, financial institutions and retailers. No public MW capacity.
